 The ten most recent matches in the sample average 3.50 cards, compared with 4.25 across all 20 matches analysed.
 How does David Dickinson distribute yellow cards between home and away teams?
 Across the 20 matches analysed, home teams average 1.85 yellow cards and away teams 2.20. This describes the sample; it does not, on its own, establish favouritism.
